body:
RedeemViewModel.redeem() passes the text field value straight to the API, so
pasting a full invite link (e.g. https://host/invite/<token>, including under a
path prefix like /shopping/invite/<token>) fails — only the bare encoded token
works. Extract the token from the /invite/<token> URL when one is pasted, while
still accepting a bare token. (The App-Link deep-link path already extracts the
token in Nav.kt; this is the manual-paste path in the redeem dialog/screen.)
title: Android: redeeming a pasted invite should accept the full URL, not only the bare token
